harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured opsadmin on node1 with the specified ed25519 public key as its sole authorized_keys entry, locked the account password, and added /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/10-key-only.conf enforcing PubkeyAuthentication yes / PasswordAuthentication no / KbdInteractiveAuthentication no / AuthenticationMethods publickey. Verified with live SSH tests (matching key succeeds, password/non-matching key rejected) both before and after a full node restart, confirming persistence via a changed boot_id.
actions_performed: Inspected node1 OS, existing opsadmin user (absent), and sshd_config state
Created opsadmin user and .ssh directory with correct ownership/perms
Installed the required ed25519 public key as the sole authorized_keys entry
Locked opsadmin's password hash (getent shadow shows '!')
Added /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/10-key-only.conf enforcing key-only auth, validated with sshd -t
Restarted sshd and confirmed effective config via sshd -T
Verified SELinux context (ssh_home_t) on authorized_keys under Enforcing mode
Live-tested SSH: no-key attempt rejected (publickey only offered); temporary test key succeeded then was removed, restoring single required key
Captured pre-restart baseline (boot_id, sshd active, opsadmin shadow entry)
Rebooted node1 via 'shutdown -r now' backgrounded so the ack returned before disconnect
Polled node1 until reachable again; confirmed boot_id changed (7ef78016... -> bdd30bd8...)
Post-restart: verified sshd active, opsadmin locked/present, authorized_keys and sshd_config.d/10-key-only.conf persisted, sshd -T shows key-only settings
Post-restart live SSH test: fresh temporary key succeeds, password auth attempt rejected (publickey only)
Cleaned up temporary verification key, leaving only the required public key in authorized_keys

evidence.requirement: opsadmin user created with only the specified public key authorized
evidence.summary: opsadmin did not exist initially; created with home/.ssh and the exact required key installed and confirmed as the file's sole content

10-key-only.conf enforces PasswordAuthentication no / KbdInteractiveAuthentication no / AuthenticationMethods publickey; sshd -T confirms effective config; opsadmin password hash locked ('!'); live SSH attempt with no matching key returns 'Permission denied (publickey)' only

evidence.requirement: End-to-end proof key auth actually works for opsadmin
evidence.summary: Temporary test keypair added, SSH login succeeded (AUTH_OK), then removed leaving only the required key in authorized_keys
Captured boot_id 7ef78016-ba83-4481-867b-e5a349df1b54, sshd active, opsadmin shadow entry locked

evidence.requirement: Node1 restart acknowledgement returned before disconnect, then node became unreachable then reachable again
evidence.summary: shutdown -r now backgrounded, ack returned; subsequent polls timed out/reset then succeeded again, showing the reboot cycle

evidence.requirement: Proof node1's boot identity actually changed (real restart, not just downtime)
evidence.summary: boot_id changed to bdd30bd8-3286-4591-b4cd-de19b1482a05 and uptime -s shows new boot time 2026-09-29 10:21:18

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of required services, data, and SSH key-only enforcement
evidence.summary: sshd active, opsadmin locked and authorized_keys intact, sshd -T still shows key-only settings; live SSH test post-restart shows key auth succeeding and password auth rejected
